title: Find drivers who competed in both the 2017 Canadian Grand Prix and the 2017
question: Find drivers who competed in both the 2017 Canadian Grand Prix and the 2017 Hungarian Grand Prix, and return their full names, nationalities, and average points across all races they participated in during 2017. Only include drivers whose average points in 2017 were greater than 5. Order the results by average points in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH canadian_2017 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017 AND r.XCL_069 = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
),
hungarian_2017 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017 AND r.XCL_069 = 'Hungarian Grand Prix'
),
eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT c.driver_id
    FROM canadian_2017 c
    INNER JOIN hungarian_2017 h ON c.driver_id = h.driver_id
),
avg_points_2017 AS (
    SELECT ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id, AVG(ds.XCL_030) AS avg_points
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017
    GROUP BY ds.XCL_029
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041, ap.avg_points
FROM eligible_drivers ed
INNER JOIN drivers d ON ed.driver_id = d.XCL_034
INNER JOIN avg_points_2017 ap ON ed.driver_id = ap.driver_id
WHERE ap.avg_points > 5
ORDER BY ap.avg_points DESC

WITH canadian_2017 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017 AND r.XCL_069 = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
),
hungarian_2017 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017 AND r.XCL_069 = 'Hungarian Grand Prix'
),
eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT c.driver_id
    FROM canadian_2017 c
    INNER JOIN hungarian_2017 h ON c.driver_id = h.driver_id
),
avg_points_2017 AS (
    SELECT ds.XCL_029 AS driver_id, AVG(ds.XCL_030) AS avg_points
    FROM driverStandings ds
    INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017
    GROUP BY ds.XCL_029
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041, ap.avg_points
FROM eligible_drivers ed
INNER JOIN drivers d ON ed.driver_id = d.XCL_034
INNER JOIN avg_points_2017 ap ON ed.driver_id = ap.driver_id
WHERE ap.avg_points > 5
ORDER BY ap.avg_points DESC

FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.XCL_034 = ds.XCL_029
INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2017
  AND d.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT ds2.XCL_029
    FROM driverStandings ds2
    INNER JOIN races r2 ON ds2.XCL_028 = r2.XCL_065
    WHERE r2.XCL_066 = 2017 AND r2.XCL_069 = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  )
  AND d.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT ds3.XCL_029
    FROM driverStandings ds3
    INNER JOIN races r3 ON ds3.XCL_028 = r3.XCL_065
    WHERE r3.XCL_066 = 2017 AND r3.XCL_069 = 'Hungarian Grand Prix'
  )
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041

WITH target_races AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_065 AS race_id
    FROM races r
    JOIN seasons s ON r.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
    WHERE s.XCL_091 = 2017
      AND r.XCL_069 IN ('Canadian Grand Prix', 'Hungarian Grand Prix')
),
drivers_in_both AS (
    SELECT res.XCL_075 AS driver_id
    FROM results res
    JOIN target_races tr ON res.XCL_074 = tr.race_id
    GROUP BY res.XCL_075
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.XCL_074) = 2
),
avg_points_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        AVG(res.XCL_082) AS avg_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    JOIN seasons s ON r.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
    WHERE s.XCL_091 = 2017
    GROUP BY res.XCL_075
)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_037 || ' ' || d.XCL_038 AS full_name,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    ap.avg_points
FROM drivers_in_both dib
JOIN drivers d ON dib.driver_id = d.XCL_034
JOIN avg_points_2017 ap ON dib.driver_id = ap.driver_id
WHERE ap.avg_points > 5
ORDER BY ap.avg_points DESC
